population.inclusion: Patients <18 years of age; Prolonged febrile illness (≥5 days) in a patient with ≥2 of the principal clinical features of Kawasaki disease.; Patients with fever and ≥4 principal clinical features; Infants with fever for ≥7 days without other explanation
